TestNoStringLiteralCrShipsCallsARecordVerified and TestNoRenderingOfACitedRecordCallsItVerified scan shipped strings and renderings; a grep of non-test string literals for verified/confirmed/proven found none describing a record.

TestNoChannelOverridesTheArguedForcing and TestAnArguedAssertionIsRefusedNamingTheRecord pass.

dropped before output at merge (cli/merge.go:261-265) and again at record (cli/recorddrops.go:55-68), never written; counted in summary.json waived (merge.go:207-211).

--pr and -o are required flags and repo is resolved. Merge grades in memory, drops waived and already-posted records, marks duplicates, and counts by role, axis, severity and grade. A missing required field returns RejectedRecordError with File, Line and Field, which exit.go:288 maps to ExitValidation (1). DecodePerRole is the path cr merge uses.
marker carries id, kind, path, start_line, line, severity, grade, disposition in that order (MarkerFields 76, markerOf 107).

suggestion fence inside the body; rule-origin suggestions carry the machine-generated label.
HTML-comment header with counts, coverage line, and CommentCapFor disclosure against post.max_comments; TestTheDraftHeaderReportsTheCountTheCapCheckUses.
agent region only, rendered with no preserved bodies, replaced whole at publish (cli/draft.go:460-464); TestAnEditedBodyNeverBecomesItsRenderedEntry.

produceDraft ingests the current draft first: deletions become discards, with waivers written by waiveDiscards. Differing bodies are preserved. queueRecords renders only draft/queued states, so a discarded block is never resurrected.

regradeTriaged recomputes every record's grade after anchor edits and aborts a hardening that is not probed or cited. Then ForceQuestions and RefuseArguedAssertion run over the queued comments before buildPayload.
An unknown id aborts with exit 1 instead of being adopted. No path creates a record from a block.

events overwrite in place by key; raised at draft, discard outcomes at draft, one outcome per queued record after a confirmed send (cli/send.go recordPostTriage), none without --confirm (TestAPostWithoutConfirmWritesNoTriageEvent); events carry class/axis/role/grade/rule/PR/round/head. Key holds action as raised-vs-outcome, per task triage-event-writing's acceptance.
Tally by class and by rule, reported by cr stats (cli/stats.go:22-69).
new_classes written to the round summary by cr draft (cli/draft.go:499, cli/triage.go:48) and first_seen reported by cr stats (cli/stats.go:39).
(wrong + softened)/raised, not-here excluded via CountsAgainstClass, strict threshold, min samples.
DemotionBound reported as demotion_rate_bound and the field is named rate_lower_bound (cli/stats.go:57-58).
not-here rate over the same Sample, reported separately as volume_candidates (cli/stats.go:68).
cr stats only reads the ledger and settings and emits a report; no write path to rule files.

Determinism is structural: git runs with pinned -c config and an allowlisted environment, gh likewise (gh/run.go:100-125), ids are derived from state. No single test asserts whole-command reproducibility; recorded_at-style timestamps in journals are provenance, not outputs of judgement.

gh.Run refuses any invocation it cannot read as a read (run.go:137-142); Write needs a Confirmation minted only by gh.Confirm, whose sole caller is cr post's gate (post.go:313); git runner has no push. nowrite_test guards the mint sites.

Hits carry no verdict (rule/detect.go); suppression by a human thread comes only from the agent's suppressed_by (finding/fields.go:99, cli/record.go:245); reinvention is candidates only (internal/reinvention); coverage and mapping come from agent-recorded cells and pairs.
key (path, class, anchor content_hash) plus side per task waiver-key's acceptance; summary excluded; scope derived from disposition (176-184).
exact equality on the content hash of the anchored lines, which cr stamps (cli/recordanchors.go:24-35), so a change to those lines stops the match; no looser comparison exists.
Scope is derived from disposition only: wrong -> repository, not-here -> pull request; appendWaiver (waiverstore.go:132-145) is the only file selection, no caller passes a scope.

Repository file via state/layout.go:151-155 (~/.cr/waivers/<owner>/<repo>.ndjson), PR file via per-PR waivers.ndjson; both readable and removable through cr waivers list/remove (cli/waivers.go:110-146, 249-284).
Waiver embeds Disposition (json disposition); WaiverFor reads it off the record and refuses an unknown one; written by regenerate.go:293-306.

DropWaived runs over both waiver files in cr merge and again in cr record (recorddrops.go:56-60), so a waived finding never reaches findings.ndjson or the draft. The waived count goes to summary.json (merge.go:236). A waiver created after a record is stored does not un-draft it, which is consistent with §6.4.4.

list reads repo file alone without --pr, both with --pr, prints scope (derived) and disposition; remove <id> at waivers.go:249-284 deletes from either scope via finding.RemoveWaiver. Tests: cli/waivers_test.go, cli/waiversremove_test.go.

WaiverProvenance holds round, pr, head, reason(omitempty) and validate refuses missing round/pr/head; regenerate.go:299-301 supplies round/PR/head. Reason is never populated, but §7.2 offers no channel to give one in v0.1.

render.lang defaults to tr (config.go:76, pinned by config_test.go:261); ParseLang closes the set (render/lang.go:48-111); label and review body are rendered in the resolved lang (post.go:321,363). Agent prose language is the agent's per §8.1.2.

body() places summary and evidence verbatim with no composed words; the agent region at post time is the one read back from draft.md (draft/post.go:34-49, cli/post.go:218-241). No body flag exists on any command (only flags: confirm, reconcile, pr, output, dead, resolved, globals).

Fixed label/provenance/body/evidence order in Comment.String; named pairs recovered by AgentRegion; ValidateBody refuses empty or Reserved-bearing body; BodyError maps to exit 1 (cli/exit.go:189-191).
A literal built-in table per lang and grade names the register (Soru/Question) and the grade. It is not configurable. QuestionLabelRegion refuses to render a question with no table row.
ValidatePostBody refuses a question agent region with no ?, naming the record; called from draft.PostBodies (draft/post.go:43) on cr post's payload path; BodyError -> exit 1.

All three triggers (suggestion_origin rule, a claim resting on a note, a rule-origin citation with its rationale) feed a cr-owned region. That region is rendered by the same commentOf path that PostBodies uses for the posted body (post.go:575). A missing rationale refuses.
cited -> path:line per citation, probed -> kind/target/filter/result/input/output_tail (render/evidence.go:53-124); regenerated in commentOf at draft and post; missing probe refused.

problemWith refuses a non-RIGHT anchor, a non-contiguous range, and a range the diff does not carry on RIGHT; wired through cli/positions.go:28-44 from cr post (post.go:238). Tests: suggestion/validate_test.go, cli/positions_test.go.
Containment asked of the whole range against a single hunk; a range whose ends sit in two hunks is refused with its own message.
When the leading whitespace of the first lines differs, a warning quotes both lines. cr draft surfaces it (draft.go:243, 274). It never refuses, so post goes ahead with the block left as written.
suggestion.Validate returns RangeError{Record} (exit 1, exit.go:196) for every queued record before the payload is built and before the --confirm gate.

post.Create sends the whole payload as one gh api POST (Request 214-221); buildReview refuses a second review for a posted round via refusePostedRound (post.go 429-451, exit 4). TestAMultiCommentRoundIsOneReviewCreationCall and TestConfirmSendsOneReviewAndSettlesTheRound pass at -count=1.

event is an unexported const COMMENT with no setter; Build (86) and Payload (109-111) both stamp it, so an overwritten Event never leaves. TestAnEventWrittenOntoTheReviewDoesNotReachThePayload and TestNoStringCrShipsHoldsAVerdictEvent pass.

Preimage joins path/start_line/line/side/body by LF, orders by path, start_line, line, side, numeric id, excludes the review body, hashes via text.NormalisedHash. posted.json written before the call (send.go:81, cli/posted.go:71-92) and thread ids adopted after (send.go:173-187).

validatePositions holds every queued record to suggestion.Validate and positionInDiff before the call; buildReview runs it (post.go 289) before buildPayload and the gate. TestAnUnplaceablePositionStopsThePostBeforeAnythingIsSent and TestACommentMovedOutsideTheDiffIsRefusedBeforeTheCall pass.

postOutcome returns post.RejectedError (every position with its record id, reject.go 123-149; 4xx less 408 only) and clears post_unresolved; markPosted/waivers/outcome events sit only on send's success branch (send.go 121-147). exit.go 442 codes RejectedError 4. TestARejectedCallNamesEveryPositionAndMovesNothing and TestARejectedCallMarksNothingPosted pass.

ReviewBody puts active axes and every lens that did not run above PayloadHashComment(hash); discloseInBody (post.go 605-618) takes the hash over comments before setting the body and lenses from lensesOf, the status derivation. English regardless of render.lang per the 2026-09-13 user decision.

post_unresolved set before the call, UnknownOutcomeError (exit 4) for non-4xx/408/unparseable or no node_id, no retry branch; send refuses while set (94-96). reconcilePost (reconcile.go 80-112) lists every review (gh.Reviews paginates, reviews.go 68-104), matches the embedded hash, adopts or clears. TestAServerErrorOrATimeoutIsAnUnknownOutcome, TestAnUnresolvedPostingIsReconciledToAnAdoptAndToAClear pass.

Every refusal runs before the gate; without --confirm the full payload is emitted with posted:false and nil error (exit 0), no write door reached. The run still performs gh reads (head per §9.3.1, lens disclosure), read as no network write. TestADryRunPrintsThePayloadAndSendsNothing, TestAnInvalidPayloadExitsOneUnderBothFlagSettings pass.

Confirmation.Write refuses without a granted token and refuses any non-api write; the token is minted only by gh.Confirm(confirmed) in buildReview (post.go 313). --reconcile performs only reads. TestTheRealSenderRefusesWithoutTheGate passes.
--confirm is read from the flag alone (156) with no alias, env or profile input; TestNoChannelButTheFlagSuppliesTheConfirmationGate and TestThePostCommandOffersTheGateExactlyOneSpelling pass.

The summary's gate keys are confirm_given and payload_hash only, written by cr post; posting.line (output.go 84-93) says '--confirm was given' and never a reading. TestTheGateReportsConfirmationAndNeverAReading passes.

Transition lines carry record, from, to, actor, head, at; Journal.Move is the only way to move and is written under the publishing lock to transitions.ndjson. Every actor uses it (record.go:305, draft.go:167, post.go:217, reconcile.go:199, brief/invalidate.go:48).
terminal lists posted, discarded, duplicate, suppressed, stale; Open derived as valid and not terminal.

RIGHT resolves against the head, LEFT against the merge base; anchor is a required field (§6.1.3 rejection). Whether a record is about a deletion is left to the agent (anchor.go:181-187); cr record also requires a LEFT anchor to fall in a hunk's base range (cli/anchorunit.go:86-99), which includes context lines.

A moved head rewrites only the state field of open records to stale; no anchor is touched, and every per-PR writer refuses the stale round (RefuseStale, post.go 191) until cr brief. TestAMovedHeadRefusesEveryWriterAndIsDisclosedToEveryReader passes.

StampAnchor computes content_hash over start_line..line and up to three context lines each side from the tree; called from cr record's settleAnchors (cli/recorddrops.go:21-29). Test: cli/anchorstamp_test.go:47.

briefedRound is the single door to per-round state and compares against GitHub's headRefOid; Round.Disclosure reports both heads (state/briefed.go:145-156). Pinned by TestBriefedIsReachedThroughOneDoor and TestEveryCommandHoldingARoundAnswersSection93.

RefuseStale returns StaleRoundError naming both heads -> exit 4 (exit.go:374); called by record, merge, post, map, claims, cells, test, sandbox, probe, waivers remove; post --reconcile returns before it (post.go:165-170). Test: movedhead_test.go:400.

roundOf increments only when the recorded head differs and keeps the index otherwise; write publishes meta.json with the new head last (store.go 58-76). Refusal while post_unresolved is the recorded user decision. TestTheRoundIndexMovesExactlyOncePerDistinctHead and TestASameHeadBriefPerformsNoneOfSection934 pass.

invalidate stales open records, clears the closing round's mapping, and re-records claims under the new stamp; units and threads are recomputed and written every brief (store.go 64-70); drift runs over stored claims and the re-read issue text with no extraction (brief.go 276-290). TestAnIncrementWritesTheRowsSection934NamesAndNoOthers passes.

Round readers go through ReadStamped for the current round; ReplaceStamped and ClearStamped keep earlier rounds' lines (state/roundscope.go 106-122). Cross-round reads are the id-uniqueness check (recordids.go) and rules suggest history, neither a round's records. TestEveryFileHoldingARoundAnswersSection93 passes.

Entries keyed as a waiver, one per posted record (AppendPosted, written by writeAdopted via recordPostedIndex); DropPosted at merge (merge.go:270-274) and again at record (recorddrops.go:61-65), counted into summary. Tests: postedindex_test.go:36,78,107.

cr status reports units total, complete, gaps and oversized from coverage.RowsOf (coverage/rows.go 37-60), counting only current-round cells at the unit's current hash for active roles. TestRowsCountCompleteRowsAndGapsAsSection1011Does and TestStatusReportsCoverageIntentAndTheLensesThatDidNotRun pass.
intentCoverageOf reports claims total, claims mapped (round-scoped pairs) and the stored unimplemented-claim entries whole, with set-aside count; Text lists each gap (136-142).

Active axes are printed (143) and statusHonesty carries every §4.5.4 lens that did not run with its reason via lenses.Verdict, the same lensesOf derivation the posted body uses; routed through writer.disclose so --quiet cannot drop it. TestTheStatusTextCarriesTheCountsAndEveryLensThatDidNotRun passes.
recordTalliesOf counts the round's findings and questions together by state, severity and grade, every vocabulary value at zero included; there is no separate by-kind cut.
probesOf reports probes run in the round and distinct probes standing behind a probed record, which is the only grade a probe can change per §6.2.
waiverDisclosure reads summary.json's waived count (distinguishing not-yet-merged from zero); duplicateDisclosure counts the round's duplicate records; both appended to honesty (status.go:333-337).

Write/Remove/WriteRound are methods on the held flock, so no per-PR write path exists without it; TestOnlyTheStatePackageWritesToTheFilesystem fences raw writes, TestConcurrentWritersSerialise passes.
ReadPR takes no lock; atomic rename publish keeps unlocked reads whole (TestAReaderProceedsWhileAWriterHoldsTheLock, TestALockFreeReadNeverSeesAPartialWrite).

All eight record types embed state.Stamp; WriteStamped/AppendStamped stamp on write and WriteRecords refuses the eight; DecodeStamped (claims, map, cells, record/merge) refuses a supplied head/round by folded key presence with ReservedFieldError exit 1 naming line+field. TestTheRecordingCommandsRefuseASuppliedHeadOrRound passes.
headReason blocks when round.Stale() (status.go:280-285).
rowReason blocks on any unit without a complete row at its current unit hash, and on a round with zero units.

claimReason blocks on unsettledClaims (status.go:419+): every round claim no pair maps, minus gap entries carrying set_aside_note; a claim with no gap entry but no pair still blocks, and mapping or set-aside clears it.

recordReason blocks on any current-round record in an open state (draft or queued, derived from §9.1.2); verdict printed with every non-running lens via Lenses.Verdict (status.go:329). Test: cli/completeness_test.go.

When the found command's ParseFlags fails, asksForJSON falls back to scansForJSON, which ignores flags pflag already parsed. Measured on a pty: `cr status abc --repo --json` prints prose, but `cr status abc --repo --json --bogus` and `cr status abc --bogus --json` print the JSON failure. An overlay probe of the same prepared tree shows pflag left json=false (repo="--json") before failing on --bogus. Only on a usage error with an unparseable flag.
emit and reportFailure both use json.MarshalIndent(..., "", "  "); --compact stays indented. TestJSONIsPrettyPrintedWithTwoSpaceIndentation passes.

withoutNilSlices deep-copies every emitted payload, filling nil slices behind pointers, interfaces, maps and embedded structs. TestNoOutputStructPrintsANullArray walks every Text-bearing payload (source-derived list) zero-valued.

Every failure is reported as error plus hintFor(err); unclaimed errors take usageHint and file failures their own step (exit.go 658-670). TestEveryRowOfTheExitTableNamesAStep and TestEveryErrorTheCommandTreeReturnsCarriesAHint pass.

compactOmits names output_tail, input, comment.body and replies.body; foundingFields evidence and citations are refused at package init. TestEveryPlaceAnIngestedThreadKeepsABodyIsOmitted and TestTheOmissionTableRefusesAFoundingField pass.

posting{posted, confirm_given} is embedded in postResult on the dry run, the send and settleDiscards; the terminal line distinguishes them. A --reconcile run performs no write and reports post_unresolved/adopted instead. TestADryRunAndAConfirmedPostAreDistinguishable and TestOnlyACommandBehindTheGateReportsPosted pass.
States the loop brief to post with human read, that v0.1 stops at posting; 479-494 says a moved head opens a new round with cr brief.
The argued rule, that nothing overrides it (with the refusal shown), and when to earn probed or cited instead of asserting.
Triage verbs table, wrong (marker edit, repository-wide, counts against class) versus not-here (deletion, PR-scoped, not counted), and the §7.2 marker field edit semantics table.
cr cannot tell whether a human read the draft, so the human must read it; 412-414 says every network write needs --confirm with no implicit channel.
Role, profile and rule file formats, each with a 'To add one' step (613, 657, 698).
A comment written by hand more than twice belongs in the rule corpus, with a detect block when mechanically matchable.
citations is the machine-readable field, evidence is prose never parsed, and a finding without citations or a supporting probe is argued and posted as a question.
Comment economy: fewer comments under post.max_comments, each anchored to its line, no unanchored channel.

One CGO_ENABLED=0 binary; non-test exec.Command sites are gh, git, the tracker argv and the profile's sandbox commands only. TestTheBinaryRunsWithNothingButGitAndGhOnPath and TestTheRunnersStartGitGhAndTheConfiguredTracker pass.
GoReleaser runs on v* tags; .goreleaser.yml:17-22 builds darwin and linux on amd64 and arm64 and archives them as tar.gz.

brews block publishes Formula/ to deligoez/homebrew-tap, installs bin cr and tests cr --version. TestAReleasePublishesTheFormulaToTheTapFromTheWorkflow passes. Not exercised against the real tap (no network).

Module path github.com/deligoez/cr (go.mod:1); without ldflags versionOf reads the module version go install recorded, so go install @<tag> prints the tag. The audit binary printed its pseudo-version v0.0.0-20260913055519-a869996110d0.
skills/cr/SKILL.md exists in the repository; marketplace.json exposes plugin cr with source ./ so the skills directory is discovered.

Root Version = versionOf(version, debug.ReadBuildInfo) (root.go:27); goreleaser ldflags -X internal/cli.version={{.Version}}. Measured audit binary prints its module pseudo-version. Configured `profile` (resolved through §2.7, per-repo config included) loads that profile and skips markers; otherwise marker files decide. brief/brief.go:234-236 wires it. TestConfigurationOverridesTheMarkerFiles.

Greatest matched marker count wins; ties return Tied and Err() gives TieError naming them, exit 3 (cli/exit.go:134); brief.go:241 and cli/rules.go:162 abort on it. TestATieBecomesAnAbortNamingTheTiedProfiles.
generic declares files: []; zero markers never match (select.go:111-116). TestTheShippedGenericProfileIsNeverSelectedAutomatically, TestTheShippedGenericProfileNeverJoinsATie.

Unprofiled disables only the test axis (and reports reinvention/test-symbol halves unavailable) via profile.Unmatched, keeps correctness/convention active, and brief/review/status disclose it (profile/none.go Disclosure). TestWithNoProfileEveryCommandRunsTheAxesThatNeedNoneAndSaysWhichDidNot passes.
Builtins embeds laravel-pest.json and generic.json; cr init writes both via EnsureProfile (cli/init.go:52-58). TestV01ShipsExactlyTheTwoProfilesOf245.
Embedded intent-coverage/intent, correctness/correctness, convention/convention, test-adequacy/test (axes confirmed in builtin/*.json). TestTheShippedRolesCoverEveryAxisExactlyOnce.
--eject-roles writes role.Builtins() content via EnsureRole. Probed: cr init --eject-roles into a temp CR_HOME, cmp of all four roles (and both profiles) against the embedded files reports identical.

Probed brief with role files: bad axis, missing title, id not stem, non-kebab id, profiles as string, unknown key, invalid JSON — each exit 3 naming file and field; profile with tests.cmd string exit 3 naming file and field.
Repo, then global, then builtin, first id wins whole; callers pass RepoRolesDir then RolesDir (cli/merge.go:253, brief). TestThePerRepositoryRoleWinsWholeAcrossAllThreeLayers.

Corpus appended layer by layer with each layer sorted by id (sortByID 220-222, not file name); Order derives §6.4.2's comparison from those positions. TestCorpusOrderIsLayerThenAscendingRoleID, TestMoreThanOneRoleMayServeTheSameAxis.
Repo, then global, then profile rules array; called from review/attach.go:71, cli/rules.go:169, cli/rulescheck.go:165.
Whole-rule shadowing by id, no field merge; duplicate id inside one profile layer refused (corpus.go:211-221).
Record carries `rule`; injected text names the id (rule/injection.go:62-70); origin/confirmation keyed on record.Rule (rule/origin.go:29, rule/fix.go:96-98).

The rationale is in every rule's prompt text (rule/injection.go:61-69, review/text.go:271-283) and in the draft's provenance region for a rule-origin citation; a rationale the corpus no longer holds refuses the draft (MissingRationaleError).

Unknown keys, bad JSON/types, required fields, enums and the detect/fix blocks (compiled at load) all return MalformedError or axis.InvalidError, both coded 3 (exit.go:106,151). TestAMalformedRuleFileExitsWithTheFileCode, TestRulesListRefusesARuleWhoseDetectBlockCannotRun, TestRecordRefuses... pass.
Only hunk Changed lines with Side==Right are matched; no repository read. Wired in review/attach.go:85 and cli/rulescheck.go:140.

mode must be regex and a pattern that fails regexp.Compile aborts at load with exit 3 naming the rule. Measured: rules/no-pattern.json with detect {"mode":"regex"} is listed by cr rules list, exit 0, so every changed line becomes a hit of that rule.

cr stamps origin: rule on a citation matching a ledger hit by head/rule/path/line (called cli/record.go:439, cli/merge.go:446); driven by cli/reviewhits_test.go:84-98. Hit.Citation() (rule/citation.go:27) has no non-test caller.
Detect-less rules of the role's axis rendered into the prompt via review/text.go:277; command test cli/ruleinjection_test.go.
Hits carry no verdict (detect.go:40-52); a hit becomes nothing unless a record naming the rule and citing path/line confirms it, else it is logged as a dismissal.
hit/record/dismissal entries with rule, path, line, round, head; written from review/attach.go:91, cli/rulescheck.go:105, cli/record.go:540; test cli/reviewhits_test.go:55-74.

A PR is the owner/repo pair (--repo or detected GitHub remote) plus a positive number; containment of owner/repo enforced in state/layout.go:341. Probed brief with --repo acme/app 1: payload carries owner, repo, pr.
Head is GitHub's headRefOid for the PR, compared on every per-round command via Layout.Briefed. Probed: brief head equals the branch tip; after a new commit brief reported the new sha.
KindQuestion asks instead of asserting.
Citation {path, line} resolved against head file content via ResolveCitations/HeadFile.
Probe record with kind, input, result, baseline, target, output_tail; run in the sandbox by cr probe run.
Grade enum probed/cited/argued, computed by ComputeGrade (finding/grade.go:171).
Render produces the editable draft of queued records; ingest reads edits back (draft/ingest.go).
Thread = opening comment plus replies, with anchor, resolution and author type; ingested via GraphQL and stored in threads.ndjson.
meta.json binds round to head; probed a pushed commit: cr status reported stale, cr brief opened round 2 at the new head and restamped claims with round 2/new head.
Waiver keyed by path/side/class/content_hash, written on discard with a disposition.
Disposition enum is exactly wrong and not-here.
Note stored per issue key in ~/.cr/context/<KEY>.ndjson, ids <KEY>#n<k>.
Issue identified by an issue key resolved from its sources (ResolveKey); meta.json carries issue_key.
Open() = valid and not terminal; terminal list is §9.1.2's five.
Claim record: id, text, source, span, hashes; recorded by cr claims record.
Hunk parsed from a unified diff's @@ header as one contiguous changed range.
Unit is built from a cluster of hunks (Units(clusters)), carrying hunk_ranges.
Role has id, title, axis, instructions (plus focus, profiles).
